Software Engineers All Levels Romania (Remote)
 Who We Are
 Employment Hero is on a mission to make employment easier and more valuable for everyone around the world. Our Employment Operating System brings hiring, HR, payroll and benefits into an all-in-one solution.
Since launching in 2014, we've grown from startup to global scale, reaching a valuation of over $2 billion and building a presence across six countries, with even more growth ahead. We now serve over 350,000 SMEs, pay more than 3 million employees, and support a growing pool of job seekers finding their next role through our platform.
We are expanding our engineering presence in Romania to establish a founding European squad. Working closely with our engineering hubs in the UK, Canada, and Vietnam, this squad directly owns customer-facing application features for fast-growing international markets.
 The EH Way
 At Employment Hero, we’re proud of our unique DNA, which we call The EH Way.
We are Mission First - Our Mission determines what we work on, where we invest, and where we focus. Every decision runs through a single filter: does this accelerate our Mission?
We are Remote First - we champion a remote environment with a preference for asynchronous communication and a high degree of autonomy
We are AI First - we are committed to using AI to accelerate our mission; AI is not just a tool, it’s a fundamental part of how we operate, innovate, and scale
We Live by Our Values - we role model our values 100% of the time
We Expect High Performance - we set a high standard and we’re not satisfied with being average
 This role
 As our Software Engineer (Junior, Intermediate, Senior, or Staff/Lead), you’ll be working with our founding European squad in Romania, collaborating closely with engineering hubs in the UK, Canada, and Vietnam, and will be instrumental in shaping customer-facing application features for fast-growing international markets across our Employment Operating System (eOS).
Your key focus areas will be
Delivering high-impact, customer-facing application features across business logic, APIs, user authentication, and interactive workflows for global markets.
Championing AI-assisted workflow execution—leveraging enterprise tools (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini) with high prompt maturity, critical validation, and architectural rigor.
Upholding software quality, code defensiveness, zero-trust security practices (OWASP Top 10), and automated testing standards.
Executing autonomously in a 100% remote, asynchronous environment across distributed global squads.
 This will include
End-to-End Feature Ownership: Driving features from initial product scoping and technical design through implementation, automated testing, code review, and production deployment.
Modern Stack Development: Building and maintaining scalable backend services and frontend user interfaces using Ruby on Rails, React/TypeScript, and .NET Core, backed by PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis.
AI-Assisted Workflow Execution: Leveraging AI agents for boilerplate generation, test drafting, and refactoring while applying human skepticism and domain knowledge to validate every output.
Application Quality & Security: Ensuring code defensiveness, robust error handling, and zero-trust security practices (OWASP Top 10) in partnership with dedicated DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure teams.
Technical Collaboration: Breaking down ambiguous business requirements into testable tasks and participating actively in peer code reviews and architectural discussions.
 Who You Are
 To thrive at Employment Hero, you’ll need to embody The EH Way - operating with focus, agility, and an obsession with impact. For this role, you’ll also bring
Experience Across Levels: Professional software engineering experience aligned with our leveling criteria: Junior (1–3 years), Intermediate (3–7 years), Senior (7–15 years), or Staff/Lead (15+ years or proven multi-team technical leadership).
Strong Technical Foundation: Solid grasp of computer science fundamentals, data structures, relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis), RESTful API design, and web architecture.
Modern Stack Flexibility: Hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails, React.js / TypeScript, or .NET Core / C#—or transferable proficiency in Java, Node.js, Python, or Go with React/Angular, alongside a genuine willingness to work across Rails and .NET.
Ownership & Systems Thinking: Direct accountability for past deliverables ("I built", "I owned"), understanding end-to-end user impact, and reasoning through concurrency and edge cases.
Output Validation & Skepticism: Rigorous automated testing strategies, strong debugging proficiency, and critical skepticism toward code (especially AI-generated code).
Asynchronous Communication: Clear, empathetic written communication (Jira, Slack, Confluence) to define problems and collaborate effectively across distributed time zones.
 What We Can Offer
 At Employment Hero, we don't just talk about a better way to work. We live it. Joining Employment Hero means you'll:
Work in a remote-first environment, giving you the autonomy to do your best work while delivering meaningful outcomes.
Be trusted to own your work, make decisions, and have a real impact from day one.
Access cutting-edge AI tools and technology (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini) that help you move faster, think bigger, and amplify your expertise.
Surround yourself with ambitious, high-performing teammates who will challenge, support and inspire you to do the best work of your career.
Own ESOP (Employee Share Options) in an AUD $2B+ Series F tech unicorn, so you can share directly in the commercial value you help create.
Celebrate together globally at our Annual Global Gathering - from Thailand, Vietnam, Bali, Dubai, and Australia to Singapore! 
 Important Compensation Note
 Please note that the salary ranges listed above serve as a general guide across our engineering tiers. We operate structured pay bands mapped to internal level steps (Junior L1 through Staff L4), with exact placement determined through our technical evaluation and leveling process during interviews. To ensure mutual alignment from the outset, we ask all applicants to complete the salary expectation question on the application form in Monthly NET RON.
 Privacy and AI Notices
We’re AI-first, so may use AI tools to review your applications and support our interviewing and hiring process. They help us cut the noise, surface great talent fast and make sure every candidate gets a fair, consistent experience. These tools do not replace human judgment and the final hiring decision sits with our team.
We verify candidate identity and location as part of our hiring process.
At Employment Hero, we are committed to safeguarding the privacy of your application data. By applying to this role, you acknowledge our Applicant Privacy Policy made available here: employmenthero.com/legals/applicant-policy/.
